description: This Java source file defines the class FileBasedTenantBackend, which implements tenant management and AMQP API methods by delegating to a FileBasedTenantService. It acts as a proxy for tenant data stored in files, maintaining architecture consistency for device, credential, and tenant APIs within the project.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantBackend
classes.description: A proxy class that manages tenant data stored in files, implementing tenant management and AMQP API methods by delegating to FileBasedTenantService.

methods.description: Delegates adding a tenant to the tenantService.

methods.description: Delegates reading tenant information to the tenantService.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Delegates updating tenant data to the tenantService.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Delegates removing a tenant to the tenantService.

methods.name: get (by tenantId)
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data by tenant ID via tenantService.
